title: Missed-Appointment Fee Waiver Provisions and Coverage Treatment by Visit Type
content:
For each visit type booked under **Appointment Scheduling**, Riverbend Regional Health sets which waiver reasons apply to a missed-appointment fee and how Medicaid and Medicare coverage are treated. The settings are identical across all seven visit types: Primary Care Office Visit, Telehealth Video Visit, Specialty New-Patient Consultation, Diagnostic Imaging Appointment (MRI/CT), Infusion Therapy Chair Appointment, Pre-Admission Testing Appointment and Outpatient Procedure Appointment.

## Provision matrix

| Provision | Setting for every visit type |
|---|---|
| The first no-show or late cancellation in the rolling count window carries no fee | yes |
| Patients with Medicaid (BadgerCare Plus) coverage are never charged missed-appointment fees | yes |
| Fees are waived for appointments missed during a declared weather closure | yes |
| Fees are waived when the patient was hospitalized at the appointment time | yes |
| Treatment of Medicare patients for missed-appointment fees | the same as all non-Medicaid patients |

## Waiver reasons that waive a missed-appointment fee

The same list applies to every visit type:

| Waiver reason |
|---|
| Medicaid (BadgerCare Plus) member |
| first occurrence |
| weather closure |
| patient hospitalized |
| Riverbend delay |

## Provision questions

**Does a Medicare patient have a separate fee treatment?** No. For every visit type, Medicare patients are treated for missed-appointment fees the same as all non-Medicaid patients.

**Does the BadgerCare Plus provision differ by visit type?** No. Every visit type carries the setting that patients with Medicaid (BadgerCare Plus) coverage are never charged missed-appointment fees.

**Is the waiver-reason list shorter for any visit type?** No. Every visit type lists the same five reasons: Medicaid (BadgerCare Plus) member, first occurrence, weather closure, patient hospitalized and Riverbend delay.
